model_annotations.English: Figure 5 presents a bar chart comparing the performance of various reinforcement learning methods across three domains—Mathematics, MATH, and Physics—measured by Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The horizontal axis lists the domains, while the vertical axis quantifies accuracy. The chart displays four distinct methods: GRPO (blue bars), SRPO (green bars), GRPO with self-reflection (orange bars), and SRPO with self-reflection (red bars). In each domain, the bars are grouped side-by-side, with the legend indicating the color coding for each method. In Mathematics, GRPO achieves approximately 60% accuracy, SRPO achieves around 80%, GRPO with self-reflection reaches about 85%, and SRPO with self-reflection reaches approximately 90%. In MATH, GRPO scores about 65%, SRPO about 80%, GRPO with self-reflection about 85%, and SRPO with self-reflection about 90%. In Physics, GRPO scores roughly 60%, SRPO about 80%, GRPO with self-reflection about 85%, and SRPO with self-reflection about 90%. The bars for SRPO with self-reflection are consistently the tallest in each category, indicating the highest accuracy across all domains. The bars for GRPO are consistently the shortest, indicating the lowest accuracy across all domains. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the domains listed on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard color coding.
